This application coming on for admission this day, the c  following:

ORDER T he applicant has filed this first application under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure,
1973 for grant of anticipatory bail.

2. Applicant apprehends his arrest in connection with Crime No.57 of 2024 registered at Police Station Jahagirabad, District Bhopal for the offence punishable under Sections 376 and 376(2)(n)
and 506 of IPC.
3.

Prosecution story, in short, is that the prosecutrix made a complaint to the police alleging that one year ago, she got acquainted with the petitioner through face book and on the false pretext of marriage, he continue made 2 MCRC-21238-2024 physical relationship with her.
On the basis of aforesaid, crime has been registered.

4. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant has been falsely implicated in the case.
He is not concerned with the case directly or indirectly.
It is also submitted the the prosecutrix is a major woman of aged about 27 years.
It is further submitted by learned counsel for the applicant that specific allegation has not been levelled against the applicant.
It is also submitted that in order to extort money from the applicant, prosecutrix has lodged false FIR against him.
There is no likelihood of his absconsion, if he is granted the benefit of anticipatory bail.
He is permanent resident of District Bhojpur (Bihar).
He is ready to abide by all the terms and conditions as may be imposed by this Court.
With the aforesaid submissions, prayer for anticipatory bail is made.

5. On the other hand, learned Public Prosecutor for the respondent/State has opposed the anticipatory bail application by contending that on the false pretext of marriage, applicant committed rape upon the prosecutrix.
It is also contended that the applicant is a resident of Bihar and therefore, there is possibility of his absconsion.
On such grounds, he prayed for its rejection.

6. After hearing rival contentions and going through the impugned order, this Court finds that the prosecutrix is a major lady of aged about 27 years and investigation is already completed and chalan has already been filed in the matter.
Therefore, this Court finds that there is no need for custodial interrogation of the present applicant in the matter.

7 . Accordingly, without commenting on merits of the case, the instant application is allowed and it is directed that in the event of arrest, applicant be released on bail on furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.1,00,000/-
3 MCRC-21238-2024 (Rupees One Lakh) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Arresting Officer (Investigating Officer).
8 . The applicant shall make himself available for interrogation by the Investigating Officer as and when required.

He shall further abide by the other conditions enumerated in sub-section (2) of Section 438 of Cr.P.C.
9.
